$schema: Nusuk DL template contract v1 (see 14-templates-and-patterns.md; DESIGN.md › M9T)
name: Cost breakdown sheet
job: The amounts of one request, readable in a glance.
useFor: Showing the amounts of a paid request.
notFor: Paying (use Payment) or tracking (use Request tracking).

forbidden: Opening from a page that is not the request.

allowed: BottomSheet with PaymentDetails and DetailsListItem rows.

forbidden: A Primary that restarts a purchase.

rules: Digits 0 to 9, amounts with the currency sign, numbers isolated in Arabic text (M6).
The sheet traps focus and returns it on close (M10).
Tax and invoice numbers can be copied.

allocation.App level: L4 · the artefact inside the request.

measure.success: Requests to support for an invoice or a receipt
